description: Throwaway engine test for speech bubble barks: a person NPC in view says a bark in a bubble over their head (long lines in pages), an NPC in another room and a phone contact still use the toast.
test_objective: Verify bark routing (bubble in view; toast out of view, in the dark, under a minigame and for phone contacts), paging of a 150-character bark, the remainder toast on leaving view, and the pixel-art bubble
